# Collectron: Liberated Collectron Station

__Liberated Collectron Station__

*It's getting hard to tell who was liberated in this scenario...*

__Overview__

The Liberated Collectron Station sends out a heavily modified Liberator with a curious allegiance to the Mothman.

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Drop Rate** |
| Torn Mothman Wing | *25%* |
| Glowing Resin | *25%* |
| Starlight Berries | *25%* |
| Mothman Egg | *25%* |

- Production Rate: 1 item every 9 minutes
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: All other Collectron Stations
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 7

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of collected items

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop:
 - Liberated Collectron Station: 700 Atoms
 - X Bundle: X Atoms (includes Liberated Collectron Station)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
